summary: EF 发布 Glamsterdam 重定价影响说明：EIP-8037 和 EIP-8038 调整状态创建和访问成本，回放历史主网交易显示少数合约依赖被改变的 gas 假设，多数问题提高 gas limit 即可修复，合约维护者可在 repricing-impact 页面查询地址并在 Platåberget 上测试。EIP-8141 区块执行 gas 先于退款计算的修改合并，EIP-8390 以 Draft 合并。kevaundray 提交后量子就绪的存款合约 EIP。当晚召开 ACDT #93。

items.topic: Glamsterdam 重定价对合约的影响
items.title: EF 博客：Glamsterdam 重定价影响
items.note: EIP-8037 提高并统一新状态（新账户、新存储槽、部署字节码）的成本并单独计量；EIP-8038 提高 `SSTORE`、`SLOAD`、冷账户访问、`EXTCODESIZE`/`EXTCODECOPY` 的成本。状态操作 gas 上次调整是 2021 年 Berlin；新价格表按支持约 3 倍基础吞吐量的性能目标推导，是继续提高 gas limit 的前提。
items.note_en: . EIP-8037 raises and harmonizes the cost of new state (new accounts, new storage slots, deployed bytecode) and meters it separately; EIP-8038 raises the cost of `SSTORE`, `SLOAD`, cold account access and `EXTCODESIZE`/`EXTCODECOPY`. State operation gas was last adjusted in Berlin in 2021; the new schedule is derived from a performance target supporting roughly 3x base throughput and is a prerequisite for raising the gas limit further.

summary_en: The EF published the Glamsterdam repricing impact note: EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 change the cost of creating and accessing state; replaying historical mainnet transactions shows a small set of contracts rely on gas assumptions that shift, most issues are fixed by a gas-limit increase, and maintainers can look up their address on the repricing-impact page and test on Platåberget. The EIP-8141 change accounting block execution gas before refunds was merged, and EIP-8390 merged as a Draft. kevaundray submitted a post-quantum-ready deposit contract EIP. ACDT #93 was held in the evening.
